assumptions.choice: Implemented the entry+stop bracket as a manually linked 2-order structure: the entry order fires, and on its Completed notification a separate Stop order is submitted at entry_price*(1±stop_pct); the stop is canceled if the SMA-cross exit fires first.
assumptions.reason: backtrader's literal buy_bracket()/sell_bracket() API always creates a 3-leg bracket (entry + stop + take-profit limit). The spec only calls for a protective stop, no take-profit level, so adding a limit leg would be an unrequested extra rule. This manual 2-order structure preserves the bracket semantics the spec describes (stop attached to entry, replaced/canceled on position change) without inventing a take-profit price.

assumptions.choice: Entries and SMA-cross exits use default Market orders (self.buy()/self.sell()/self.close()); only the protective stop uses exectype=bt.Order.Stop.
assumptions.reason: Spec does not specify an order type for entries/exits, so the canonical default plain order call is used; the Stop exectype is used only for the explicitly described protective stop-loss.
